items.title: Fans Debate Whether the Bikini Woman From the First Trailer Is Actually Lucia
items.summary: Two years later, the trailer's most debated woman has an answer. Maybe.
items.body: Players say the woman in the first GTA 6 trailer is a separate character and not Lucia, reviving a debate that dates back to December 2023, according to VGTimes. The conclusion comes from players comparing the finished game with the trailer. It's a fan identification, not an official statement from Rockstar.
items.x_post_text: After two years of debate, #GTA6 players now say the woman in the bikini from the first trailer is a separate character, not Lucia. Fan identification, not confirmed by Rockstar. #GTAVI

items.title: GTA 6 Fans Retaliate Against the Ocarina of Time Remake on Metacritic
items.summary: A 99 tie, and now the fan wars have a Hyrule front.
items.body: After GTA 6 tied Ocarina of Time at 99 on Metacritic, GTA 6 fans retaliated against the Ocarina of Time remake with review bombing, according to VGTimes. The results were mixed.
items.x_post_text: After #GTA6 tied Ocarina of Time at 99 on Metacritic, GTA fans reportedly review-bombed the Ocarina of Time remake in retaliation, with mixed results. The fan wars have arrived. #GTAVI

items.title: 13 Beginner Tips From Early Players: RideMe Rides, the 20,000 Dollar Cash Limit, Suppressors and the Gym
items.summary: Spoiler-free survival tips from people who already lost their cash to a bad death.
items.body:
An Inven Global player guide collects practical lessons from the first days:

- Chapters 1 and 2 are for exploring. Serious cash opens in Chapter 3, with Jason's missions introducing the fences Tyrone and Yasmani.
- Hold Right on the D-Pad to ask your partner for help: create a cop distraction, take the wheel, or sell your stash (slightly lower payout than selling in person).
- Lucia and Jason don't share ammo or healing items. Weapons bought by one become available to both, but customization is per character.
- There's no instant fast travel. Hail a ride through the RideMe app: tipping 5 dollars up to twice speeds up the driver, or pay 100 dollars for instant travel.
- Join a gym and track fitness in the Health app. Skipping workouts causes muscle loss and lowers your max health cap. Eating temporarily raises max health and drinks boost stamina and focus.
- Press L3 and R3 together to pinpoint the direction of nearby sounds, which is how many unmarked events start.
- Prioritize suppressors in heavy firefights: they muffle gunshots and delay police response, but don't prevent all reports.
- Watch fuel and engine condition. The Scooter Bros app delivers a repaired vehicle for a fee, and premium membership includes three free deliveries per day.
- You can carry only 20,000 dollars. Deposit extra cash at an ATM via the Buck Me app, since dying with cash risks losing it.
- Hold Down on the D-Pad for Cinematic Camera mode (autopilot), which obeys traffic laws strictly, so heavy traffic can stall it.

These are one guide's findings, so details may change with patches.
items.x_post_text: #GTA6 early tips: you can only carry $20,000, so deposit extra via Buck Me. Press L3+R3 to find sound cues, use RideMe for fast travel, skip the gym and lose muscle. Suppressors delay cops but don't stop them. #GTAVI

items.title: GTA 6 Barely Dents Steam and Roblox: Analysts Report Over Eight Hours of Average Playtime
items.summary: Eight hours on average, and Roblox still isn't scared. Who knew kids multitask.
items.body:
Analysts reported a record share of players and an average of more than eight hours of play on GTA 6, while Steam and Roblox saw little drop in player counts, according to VGTimes. The article offers a theory for why: players seem to be adding GTA 6 on top of what they already play, not dropping other games.

The figures are analyst estimates, and platform-level data can change quickly in the first weeks.
items.x_post_text: Analysts report #GTA6 players averaging over eight hours of play, yet Steam and Roblox player counts barely dipped. People seem to be adding the game, not replacing other ones. #GTAVI

items.title: Players Accuse Rockstar of Copying a Furry Fan Illustration for a Custom SMG Decal
items.summary: A decal and a five-year-old illustration walk into a bar. The internet is the judge.
items.body:
Players noticed that a custom SMG's decal closely resembles an illustration posted nearly five years before launch, according to VGTimes. The weapon is a reward for helping furries evade police in a state where they've been outlawed, so the in-game context is part of the joke.

This is a player allegation, not a confirmed finding. I didn't see a response from Rockstar or the original artist in the material I reviewed.
items.x_post_text: Players say a custom SMG decal in #GTA6 closely resembles a furry fan illustration posted nearly five years before launch. It's an allegation, and no response from Rockstar or the artist has been reported yet. #GTAVI

items.title: Reddit's Best GTA 6 Finds So Far: Dexter's Apartment, Cash-Revealing Parrots, a Dog on a Jet Ski and Bigfoot
items.summary: Reddit found a cash-leaking parrot, a lifeguard dog and Bigfoot. Rockstar's QA team is uncomfortably quiet.
items.body:
Players have turned up a long list of oddities, most of them from Reddit posts and not independently verified:

- A Vice City building closely resembles Dexter Morgan's apartment from the TV series Dexter. You can't enter it, and the official Dexter account on X reacted to it. Reddit user y_oake23 shared it.
- At a liquor store in the Keys, a fight with angry men triggers parrots that cheer you on, and one reveals hidden cash near a generator.
- If you are stranded at sea, a dog wearing goggles and a life jacket can rescue you on a jet ski, which the report links to a real golden retriever seen riding one in Florida in 2025.
- In Chapter 2, an abandoned car with open doors and a sounding alarm leads into nearby woods, where players find a body and what looks like an alien abduction.
- A statue of four horses near Manifest Canyon makes the controller vibrate and triggers beeping when approached. One horse wears a traffic cone, possibly a nod to Glasgow's Duke of Wellington statue. Its purpose is unknown.
- During night free roam, an NPC under sniper aim reportedly becomes invincible and teleports behind the player, though it's unclear whether this is intentional or a glitch.
- Bigfoot has reportedly been seen near Cottonmouth Lake, continuing the San Andreas tradition. The report doesn't give a trigger.
items.x_post_text: Reddit's #GTA6 finds so far: a Dexter apartment lookalike, parrots that reveal hidden cash, a lifeguard dog on a jet ski, a horse statue that makes your controller vibrate, and Bigfoot near Cottonmouth Lake. Unverified, but wild. #GTAVI

items.title: Players Found a Secret Cutscene at the Top of a Leonida Tower: Seven Minutes of Climbing, One Egg
items.summary: Seven minutes of ladder, one egg and a very distracted driver. Peak Rockstar patience tax.
items.body:
X user xGarbett shared a clip of a hidden cutscene after launch. It sits at the top of one of the tallest communications towers in Leonida, and reaching it by ladder takes about seven minutes, which the finder compares with the long ladder in Metal Gear Solid 3.

How it works, according to the report: climb the tower, find a bird's nest with several large, colorful eggs, pick one up and throw it toward the road below. If it lands on a vehicle, a short cutscene plays: the egg spins through the air like a football and splatters across the car of an NPC who looks like he stepped out of 1980s Vice City, while the driver is busy on his phone. Players also say you can parachute onto the tower to skip the climb, but it takes precise timing.

It echoes the hidden secret room in the 2002 GTA: Vice City. The exact tower location and trigger conditions haven't been fully verified, so you may need to experiment with your throw.
items.x_post_text: Players found a secret #GTA6 cutscene: climb a Leonida comms tower (about 7 minutes), grab an egg from a bird's nest and throw it at a car below. Parachuting up reportedly skips the climb. Credit to xGarbett on X. #GTAVI

items.title: An NPC Conversation in GTA 6 Revives the 13-Year-Old Mount Chiliad Mystery
items.summary: Thirteen years later, Rockstar still trolls us about a mountain. Some mysteries are the content.
items.body:
Players noticed that NPCs in GTA 6 talk about the GTA 5 Mount Chiliad mystery. It happens in an early mission in which Donnie Carter sends Jason to a nearby bar: as you approach, unrelated NPCs can be overheard discussing strange events around Mount Chiliad in Blaine County. Reddit user Tr1angleChoke posted it first, and another user, SprungVenus, said they heard the same conversation, with a line about a hidden bunker with jetpacks and eggs under Chiliad.

The Chiliad mural in GTA 5 (2013), with its UFO, jetpack, egg and symbols, fueled years of theories. Rockstar later added a jetpack and a secret underground facility in the 2017 Doomsday Heist, but some fans felt the original mystery was never fully explained.

The report is based on consistent community accounts, not a firsthand check by the author. It's unknown whether it leads anywhere or is just a wink at fans. The Reddit threads contain spoilers.
items.x_post_text: An early #GTA6 mission has NPCs outside a bar chatting about the Mount Chiliad mystery from GTA 5, including a bunker with jetpacks and eggs. First spotted on Reddit. Thirteen years later, Rockstar is still teasing us. #GTAVI

items.title: BryceXD and iShowSpeed Reportedly Become the First Streamers to Finish GTA 6
items.summary: Fifty-two hours of streaming. Sleep is a side quest.
items.body: BryceXD and iShowSpeed reportedly became the first streamers to finish GTA 6, according to VGTimes. iShowSpeed streamed for 52 hours to get there. Both are early reports, and speed and completion claims will change as more players finish the story.
items.x_post_text: BryceXD and iShowSpeed reportedly became the first streamers to finish #GTA6, with iShowSpeed streaming for 52 hours. Sleep is a side quest. #GTAVI

items.title: GTA 6 Is Out: Take-Two Says $3.79 Billion on Day One, 32.5 Million Copies Pre-Ordered
items.summary: $3.79 billion in 24 hours. Somewhere, a bank vault is wearing a wanted level.
items.body:
GTA 6 launched on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, and Take-Two says it set a record. According to the company's announcement, as reported by ABC News and VGTimes, the game made $3.79 billion on its first day and 32.5 million copies were pre-ordered worldwide before launch. Take-Two calls it a record across the global entertainment industry, ahead of every previous video game, box office premiere and music release.

A few caveats: ABC describes the $3.79 billion as first-day retail sales and does not say whether it covers pre-orders or digital purchases, and the VGTimes report mixes "sold" and "pre-ordered" wording for the 32.5 million. The figures come from Take-Two's own press release, not from an independent audit.

Rockstar founder Sam Houser said in a Friday statement that it is "with immense gratitude" that the studio enters "a new chapter" with the release of GTA 6. Analysts also reported record player share, with more than eight hours of average playtime and little drop in player counts on Steam or Roblox.

No PC version is out. Analysts expect a PC port in Q1 2027, but Rockstar has not confirmed a window.
items.x_post_text: #GTA6 launched and Take-Two says it made $3.79B on day one, with 32.5M copies pre-ordered worldwide. The company calls it a record across all of entertainment. #GTAVI #Rockstar

items.title: No PC Version Yet, but Scammers Are Already Using a Fake GTA 6 PC Port as Bait
items.summary: There's no PC port. The only thing it installs is malware.
items.body:
GTA 6 is only out on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, and no PC version has been announced. Scammers are already exploiting the wait: NordVPN found a $200 dark-web scam kit that uses a fake GTA 6 PC port as bait. SteamDB also warned about a hidden Steam page using the game's name that may be malicious.

Analysts expect a PC port in Q1 2027, but Rockstar hasn't confirmed anything. Don't download "PC versions" from forums, torrents or messages, and only trust Rockstar's official channels.
items.x_post_text: No PC version of #GTA6 has been announced, but NordVPN found a $200 dark-web scam kit using a fake PC port as bait, and SteamDB flagged a suspicious GTA 6 Steam page. Don't download anything. #GTAVI

items.title: GTA 6 Hits 99 on Metacritic, Tying Ocarina of Time for the Highest Score Ever
items.summary: 99 out of 100. Critics are doing victory laps; the Metacritic page, not so much.
items.body:
Critics have spoken: GTA 6 sits at 99 on Metacritic for the PS5 version, tying The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest Metascore in the aggregator's history and beating GTA 4's 98. A TechPowerUp roundup counted 118 of 147 critic reviews as perfect scores on PS5, with no mixed or negative reviews at the time. The Xbox Series X version also shows 99, but it is based on only 14 reviews.

Perfect scores came from IGN, GameSpot, Game Informer, Edge, GamesRadar+, VGC, TechRadar, Push Square, Screen Rant and others, with Eurogamer at 5/5. GameStar gave 97, Wccftech 96, the New York Times 90 and IGN Japan 90. The lowest score in the roundup was ScreenHub's 80, whose reviewer said the game drags before it "finally lets loose." The article calls that an outlier.

Critic scores are only one side. Audiences have formed their own opinions, and the user score tells a very different story.
items.x_post_text: #GTA6 hits 99 on Metacritic, tying Ocarina of Time for the highest score ever. At the time of one roundup, 118 of 147 PS5 critic reviews were perfect scores. The lowest listed: an 80. #GTAVI

items.title: Critics Say 99, Users Say 4.9: GTA 6 Gets Hit by Review Bombing and Real Complaints
items.summary: Critics: masterpiece. Users: "this is not GTA." Pick your fighter.
items.body:
While critics gave GTA 6 a 99 on Metacritic from 152 PS5 reviews, the user score fell to 4.9 within a day of launch, based on nearly 6,800 ratings, according to VGTimes. Not all of it is organic: many low ratings look like review bombing, including zeros and one-line reviews such as "the industry's biggest flop," and one player scored it zero because it isn't on PC yet.

Still, some complaints are specific and recurring. "This is not GTA" is the most common one, with players saying it feels closer to Red Dead Redemption 2 than to the sandbox they expected. Others cite a morality system that labels you "irredeemable" if you kill too many pedestrians, a story some find boring, an empty-feeling map and slow missions. On the technical side, players mention 30 frames per second, bugs and a 200 GB-plus install. The $80 price and boxed copies that reportedly contain only a code are also frequent gripes.

The article says the backlash hasn't dented sales so far. Both numbers are real; they just measure different things.
items.x_post_text: Critics gave #GTA6 a 99 on Metacritic, but the user score fell to 4.9 within a day, with many zeros and one-line reviews that look like review bombing. "This is not GTA" is the top complaint. #GTAVI

items.title: GTA 6: The Album Sets a Spotify Soundtrack Record With 29.85 Million First-Day Streams
items.summary: Twenty-nine million streams in a day. Your neighbor's car stereo will confirm it.
items.body:
Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, released November 20, logged 29.85 million Spotify streams in its first 24 hours, a soundtrack record. The release is 34 tracks and 97 minutes long on Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube Music, with artists including Lana Del Rey, Tame Impala, Don Toliver, Keith Richards, Fred again.. and Travis Scott. Several tracks came out as singles first, the album was made with Atlantic Records, and CD and vinyl editions were announced.

Justice's original score is a separate release: 50 tracks of mission music, arriving on streaming December 11.
items.x_post_text: #GTA6: The Album logged 29.85M Spotify streams in 24 hours, a soundtrack record. 34 tracks, 97 minutes, with Lana Del Rey, Tame Impala, Don Toliver and more. Justice's score arrives Dec 11. #GTAVI #Spotify

items.title: Launch-Week Bugs: PS5 Crashes With Error CE-108255-1 and an Xbox 60 FPS Workaround That Speeds Up the Game
items.summary: Day one, and the PS5 already wants a vacation. Plan your cooling like a heist.
items.body:
Early technical issues are surfacing. Some PS5 players report GTA 6 crashing with error CE-108255-1, and reinstalling the game hasn't fixed it for them. Cooling trouble is suspected, so check that your console has airflow and is not in a closed cabinet.

On Xbox Series X, a workaround reportedly unlocks 60 FPS but also speeds up gameplay along with the frame rate, so it is a glitch, not a feature. The game runs at 30 FPS by default, which is one of the complaints in the user reviews.

Rockstar has not published fixes for these specific reports in the material I reviewed. Check the official support page for the latest patch notes.
items.x_post_text: Some PS5 players report #GTA6 crashes with error CE-108255-1 that reinstalls don't fix, with cooling suspected. On Xbox Series X a 60 FPS workaround also speeds up gameplay. Launch week bugs, on schedule. #GTAVI

items.title: Warning: Players Report PSN and Xbox Suspensions After Sharing GTA 6 Screenshots
items.summary: Your screenshot folder is now a criminal record. Turn off the auto-upload.
items.body:
Two separate reports are making the rounds. One PlayStation player says a 30-day PSN messaging ban followed sending a friend a photo of a nudist resort from the game. Sony hasn't commented. On Xbox, players report suspensions after beach screenshots were uploaded, linked to an auto-upload setting that is enabled by default.

If you play on Xbox, consider turning off automatic capture uploads before you share beach and nudity-adjacent scenes. These are individual accounts, not confirmed policy changes.
items.x_post_text: Players say a 30-day PSN messaging ban followed sharing a #GTA6 nudist resort photo, and Xbox users report suspensions after beach screenshots auto-uploaded. Turn off auto-uploads. #GTAVI #Xbox

items.title: First GTA 6 Discoveries: A Pacifist Run That Fails in Two Hours, Derailable Trains and a Batman Parody
items.summary: Rockstar built a world where even the pacifist route ends in a pileup. Chaos is a feature.
items.body:
Players are already digging into the details. A Polygon journalist tried to finish GTA 6 without killing anyone and found accidental collisions and unscripted events kept breaking the rule in under two hours. Unlike GTA 5's unstoppable train, GTA 6's can be derailed. Players also found a comic-book parody of Batman starring a hero named Ratface, a Vice City apartment complex that closely recreates the building from Dexter, and an in-game Call of Duty parody ad that jokes about unionizing.

Lawrence Sullivan, known as the Florida Joker, who had demanded $10 million from Rockstar, appears in the credits and says he voices his own lookalike character.

More finds will keep coming, so expect this list to grow.
items.x_post_text: A Polygon writer's #GTA6 no-kill challenge fell apart in under two hours. Meanwhile players found a derailable train, a Batman parody called Ratface and a Dexter apartment. Rockstar details everywhere. #GTAVI

items.title: GTA 6 Launch Week in the Real World: Soldiers Reenlist for Days Off, Schools Fight Absences, Police Issue Warnings
items.summary: A four-day weekend, a minibus pickup and a police warning. The only mission nobody planned for.
items.body:
GTA 6's launch spilled into real life. According to VGTimes, 43 US soldiers reenlisted in exchange for a four-day weekend to play the game, and one reportedly received a bonus large enough to buy more than 100 consoles. Schools in Birmingham (Ninestiles Academy is named) and Belfast offered prizes and minibus pickups to fight launch-week absences.

Police departments in Atlanta, South Fulton, Floresville and San Juan used the launch to warn people not to copy the game's crimes in real life.
items.x_post_text: 43 US soldiers reenlisted for a four-day #GTA6 weekend, schools in Birmingham and Belfast offered prizes to fight launch-week absences, and US police warned players not to copy the game's crimes. #GTAVI
